zh-CN.title: 投稿视图切换更直接
items: 投稿页固定展示清晰的标题，审批用户可直接切换“我的”和“审批”列表
官方和运营进入投稿页时默认查看待审批投稿
投稿页头部移除了与投稿无关的聊天连接状态提示

en.title: Faster submission view switching
items: The Submission header now stays clear while reviewers switch directly between Mine and Review
Official accounts and operators now open the review queue by default
The unrelated chat connection indicator has been removed from the Submission header
